_about: The chat's commands, the same in both SDKs (2026-09-26, interactive-mode spec section 3.8).
commands: the table in menu order (name, usage, description, group, details). groups: the /help headings, in order.
keys: the key table. moved: a typed name that is not a command, and the command it became.
help: what /help prints at NO_COLOR and COLUMNS=100, line for line (the leading and trailing blank line left out).
help_command: what /help <command> prints, as the notice's lines. refusals: typed lines and the notice each gets, as lines.
tip: said after the card on the built-in agent in a folder with no agent file. outside: the last line of /help.

completion: the commands whose arguments the box completes after `/<command> ` (spec 3.8), and the first-level values each offers (both boxes must equal it; the second level comes from the folder, the keys, the schedules and the notes).

history: the typed-line history file both chats keep under the profile folder (S-291): its name, the folder and file modes, how many entries are kept, and one encoded sample in prompt_toolkit's FileHistory format that both chats must read back as `entries`.
Both chats' tables must equal this one; there is no source-parsing parity test any more.

completion._note: help completes the command names; agent also offers this folder's agents and the built-in one; skills add offers the names an agent file can name; keys set|unset the provider variables; cron run the agent's schedules; memory forget your notes. Enter on an offered value inserts it and never runs the command.
